name: idax
description: Teaches coding agents to build IDA Pro databases headlessly with the idax CLI: the right slice of a universal Mach-O, app and framework bundles, batches, and images inside a dyld shared cache.

interface.shortDescription: Build IDA Pro databases from binaries and dyld caches
interface.longDescription: How to drive the idax CLI: idax binary for executables, dylibs and .app / .framework bundles — loading the host's slice of a universal Mach-O where unattended IDA takes x86_64 — several at once with --output-dir and --jobs, idax dyld-cache for frameworks inside a dyld shared cache with --load-got, and idax formats for diagnosis. Covers reading the result honestly and the working-database leftovers that make IDA refuse an input. Requires the idax CLI and IDA Professional 9.4 with idalib.
defaultPrompt: Build an IDA database for this app
Create an .i64 for AppKit from this dyld shared cache
Which architecture slice will IDA load from this binary?
